text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! Haa...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh! Waaaahhhhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: —...I lost!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I'm completely worn out... 
*pant*... *whew*...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I lost...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, I'm sorry. It looks like... I 
wasn't the one.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Is Boo-chan okay!?" "Staff members 
watching this, please go check on 
Boo-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
"That was a great run, Blast Onepiece!" 
"Good job, Boo-chan! First, get some 
rest...!"

Among the comments displayed in the VR 
space... a few could be seen expressing 
concern for Blast Onepiece.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. It's always like this. 
Humans always...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: I'm okay! Boo hasn't given up either.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
—I will definitely make everyone's wishes 
come true!

...Everyone's 'Representative Exchange 
Race' had concluded. At Mei Satake's call, 
the project participants lined up in 
formation.

There was Blast Onepiece, who had fought 
fiercely alongside them—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Yes! I won't be the representative!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Because, I lost!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Then! We make the strong ones even 
stronger! That way, maybe we'll have a 
better shot at winning!
choice_data_list: Does that mean, in other words...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You'll act as support for me? I appreciate 
the offer, but...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure you don't want to make it 
come true yourself?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! Ugh, I hate it, but... it's 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Because winning the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe is everyone's dream!"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...I understand how you feel. Now then, 
allow me to continue the announcement.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I will read out the names of the Umamusume 
selected as representatives. The first is—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: <chrname>！

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: You were chosen after all! I just knew it!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
You two aren't just strong. Horse girl and 
human, you truly trust in each other.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Then you can grow way, way bigger! You 
have my personal guarantee!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Yep, decided! I'm gonna support you all!
choice_data_list: Are you really... okay with this?
Are you really... okay with this?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who put their hopes on us wants 
to see an Umamusume win the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
If you win, the people's wishes will come 
true! And that makes me happy!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: So, I'm entrusting this to you too!

What Blast Onepiece handed over was a 
well-worn notebook. It was titled 'Human 
Diary'—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
That's something important humans have 
taught Buu up until now!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Everything I thought we'd need to win the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe... I wrote it 
all down!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: I see! I...――

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I can do the same things humans do. I 
really am living in their hearts...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I knew doing this was the right 
choice! Yup, yup, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Hey!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: —I leave it in your hands!

"The notes entrusted to me carry a 
profound weight... Embracing the feelings 
dwelling within each and every page, we'll 
take them with us--to the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe."
